sections.title: Now Showing at the Star Cinema

blocks.content:
*** THE STAR CINEMA ***
The big screen in your town - now showing!

TODAY'S FILMS

The Lost Robot  (for the whole family)
Start:  17:30        Ticket:  £6.00

City of Dreams  (adventure)
Start:  18:45        Ticket:  £8.00

Football Heroes  (sport)
Start:  20:00        Ticket:  £7.50

The Dark Forest  (mystery, for older fans)
Start:  21:15        Ticket:  £9.00

Snack bar: popcorn, sweets and cold drinks at the door.
Students and members get a free small drink - just show your card!
Doors open 20 minutes before each film. Please come early.

Have a wonderful evening at the movies!
Wortschatz: now showing – laeuft jetzt / aktuell im Kino; a ticket – eine Eintrittskarte; the start – der Beginn (Filmbeginn); to be home – zu Hause sein

blocks.prompt: What time does the film Football Heroes start?
You only have £8 and you must be inside the cinema by 21:00. You want to see the LATEST film you can. Which film do you choose? Say why (one sentence in English).
blocks.answer_key: Football Heroes. Erwartet z.B.: "I choose Football Heroes. It starts at 20:00 (before 21:00) and the ticket is £7.50, so I have enough money." (The Dark Forest faellt weg: Beginn 21:15 ist nach 21:00.)

blocks.prompt: You have £15 for two tickets. Text a friend: suggest TWO films you can see today and write the total price. (3-4 sentences in English.)
blocks.answer_key: Modelltext: „Hi! Let's go to the cinema today. We can see The Lost Robot and then Football Heroes. That is £6.00 + £7.50 = £13.50 for two tickets, so we have enough. See you there!“ (zwei Filme von der Tafel; Summe gezeigt; kurze, korrekte Saetze).

blocks.prompt: Work in pairs at the box office. One of you buys a ticket, the other one sells it. Then swap roles.

cues: Partner A (customer): Greet the seller. Ask for one ticket for a film on the board. Ask what time it starts and how much it costs. Then say thank you.
Partner B (box office): Greet the customer. Tell them the start time and the price from the board. Be friendly and wish them a nice evening.

blocks.answer_key: Erwartet: A - "Hello! One ticket for Football Heroes, please. What time does it start? How much is it?"  B - "Hello! It starts at 20:00 and the ticket is £7.50, please. Enjoy the film!" (Nuetzliche Wendungen: One ticket, please. / What time ...? / How much is it? / Here you are. / Enjoy the film!)
